title: Stiff for more than 4 hours? Go to hospital 🚨
caption:
That warning label isn't a joke 🚨
Share this with someone who skips labels 👇
sources: NHS, 'Priapism (painful erections)': an erection lasting over 4 hours is a medical emergency; go to A&E
Mayo Clinic, 'Priapism': ischemic priapism traps blood, can cause tissue damage and erectile dysfunction; treatments include aspiration and medication
US FDA label for sildenafil (Viagra): seek emergency help for erections lasting more than 4 hours
